paragraphs: Rav Yehuda bar Achotai. Mentioned in [Keritot 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.13b.13), where he said that the halakhah follows Rabbi Elazar.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Keritot names Rav Yehuda bar Achotai and spells out Rabbi Elazar in his ruling.
